enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Remain still. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Splash water on face. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Toast bread in toaster. Pour milk into glass. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer eggs to plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Clear dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on work clothes. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Place stethoscope, pen, notebook, water bottle into backpack. Zip backpack. Pick up backpack. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone for bus schedule. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put backpack on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital lobby. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Put on PPE. Review patient charts. Check vital signs of patient A. Administer medication to patient A. Assist patient B with breakfast. Change dressing on patient C. Attend morning rounds with doctor. Update patient records. Respond to call light from patient D. Assist patient D to bathroom. Check IV drip. Adjust flow rate. Document intake/output. Attend team meeting. Eat lunch in break room. Return to ward. Check vital signs of patient E. Administer medication to patient E. Assist patient F with mobility exercises. Update patient records. Hand over to next shift.

Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone for bus schedule. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put backpack on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat, rice. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir fry. Add meat. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Scoop rice from rice cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher.

Enter bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Wait for hot water. Remove clothes. Place clothes in hamper. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Lather. Rinse. Wash hair with shampoo. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine and doing laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Open washing machine door. Pick up dirty clothes from hamper. Sort clothes. Place clothes into washing machine. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Press start button. Check machine is running. Wait for a few minutes. Open washing machine door. Take out wet clothes. Place clothes into dryer. Close dryer door. Press start button. Check dryer is running. Leave bathroom.

Enter living room. Turn on living room light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Get up. Go to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off living room light. Leave room.

enriched_activities.activity: Using phone and winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Reply to messages. Watch videos. Put down phone. Turn off bedroom light. Lie down on bed. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Remain still. Sleep.
